usage: deskops [-h] [--debug]
               {about,doctor,status,faq,bootstrap,init,inbox,message,promote,drawer,add,edit,bind,next,list,show,advance,repo,desk,atoms,graph,materialize,drift,closeout,runtime} ...

deskops: Workflow-domain layer for the hum-ecosystem.

positional arguments:
  {about,doctor,status,faq,bootstrap,init,inbox,message,promote,drawer,add,edit,bind,next,list,show,advance,repo,desk,atoms,graph,materialize,drift,closeout,runtime}
    about               Print a short overview of deskops and its first-use commands.
    doctor              Detect and repair common broken desk states safely.
    status              Deprecated alias for `deskops doctor`; show current workspace and workflow status.
    faq                 Browse the first-use FAQ by question.
    bootstrap           Install or repair sldb and register deskops models in the global store.
    init                Initialize a local .sldb store and scaffold desk/ if needed.
    inbox               Deprecated alias for `deskops message`; use message send/list/read/ack.
    message             Send, list, read, or acknowledge cross-desk messages.
    promote             Promote inbox notes into loose drawer candidates. Drawer items become tasks only by authoring them with `deskops add task`.
    drawer              Manage deferred drawer entries.
    add                 Create desk workflow artifacts from modeled templates.
    edit                Update one field on a modeled desk artifact.
    bind                Bind workflow context artifacts to tasks.
    next                Show the next valid workflow action for a task without mutating it.
    list                List desk workflow artifacts.
    show                Show one desk workflow artifact by selector.
    advance             Advance an operational artifact through the desk's lifecycle graph.
    repo                Repository registration and discovery.
    desk                Desk workspace management.
    atoms               Atom model and namespace management.
    graph               Build and inspect deskops KGDB graph runtime outputs.
    materialize         Render tracked desk role prompts into installed pi-agent files.
    drift               Check for role-agent drift between tracked role docs and installed agent files.
    closeout            Workflow closeout operations.
    runtime             Manage the live Herdr runtime for this DeskOps desk.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --debug               Print a full traceback for unexpected errors.

Typical flow:
  deskops bootstrap
  deskops init .
  deskops add task --root . --title "Fix thing" --goal "..." --scope "..." --validation "pytest"
  deskops list tasks --root .
  deskops show task task-fix-thing --root .
  deskops advance task task-fix-thing --root .

Use docs/quickstart.md for the first full walkthrough.
